summary: Cleanse without compromise. A sulfate-free body wash that respects and replenishes the skin’s natural acid mantle.
description: Gentle biological cleansing. This low-foaming gel utilizes mild, coconut-derived surfactants to lift dirt and sweat, while actively depositing skin-identical lipids back into the epidermis during the wash phase.
technical_overview: Offered at $22.0 for 300ml, this KoColor SHOWER_GEL is expertly formulated with Water, Sodium Cocoyl Isethionate, Glycerin, and Ceramides. It delivers a high-fidelity Amber Wash color profile (`#FFBF00`) and leverages pH-optimized surfactant technology.

dynamic_attributes.label: Usage Notes
dynamic_attributes.body: Massage onto wet skin using hands or a biological sea sponge.

dynamic_attributes.label: Expert Tip
dynamic_attributes.body: Ditch the harsh plastic loofah; this lipid-rich formula is best applied by hand to ensure maximum absorption of the hydrating actives.

dynamic_attributes.label: Formulation Insight
dynamic_attributes.body: Sodium Cocoyl Isethionate offers excellent cleansing power while maintaining a large enough molecular size to prevent penetration and irritation of the skin barrier.
